inspection.source_name: Factory floor with marked pedestrian walkway
inspection.analysis_provider: Recorded vision review + YOLO object-detection annotations
inspection.analysis_summary: The clip shows an indoor factory floor with large machinery on the left and a wide central aisle. A green pedestrian route bordered by yellow lines runs along the right side. Across the reviewed timestamps, workers are visible walking or standing in the central aisle outside that marked route. The recording does not clearly establish whether the route is mandatory for every activity. No clear spill, fire, sparks, major dust plume, moving vehicle, or machine-guarding defect is supported by the supplied frames.

events.visible_evidence: A worker is visible in the central concrete aisle rather than inside the green pedestrian route bordered by yellow floor lines on the right side of the factory floor.
events.why_it_matters: Walking outside a marked pedestrian route may increase the chance of interaction with nearby machinery, material movement, or vehicle traffic. The footage alone does not establish the site rule or whether the movement was authorised.
events.recommended_follow_up: Confirm that the green/yellow marking is the designated pedestrian route for this area, then review the task and reinforce the site traffic-separation procedure where applicable.
